# Lehigh Valley Health Network

> LVHN provides comprehensive healthcare services across the Lehigh Valley region with integrated patient portals, provider directories, and digital health tools.

Lehigh Valley Health Network (LVHN) operates multiple specialized institutes including cancer care, pediatrics, cardiology, orthopedics, and surgical services. The organization prioritizes patient access through digital platforms like MyLVHN and maintains WCAG 2.0 accessibility compliance across all web properties.

## Key Topics

- MyLVHN Patient Portal
- Doctor and Provider Search
- Hospital Locations and Facilities
- ExpressCARE Urgent Care
- Medical Records Access
- Online Bill Payment
- Lehigh Valley Reilly Children's Hospital
- Lehigh Valley Topper Cancer Institute
- Lehigh Valley Heart and Vascular Institute
- Lehigh Valley Orthopedic Institute
- Virtual Care Services
- Weather Alerts and Service Updates
- WCAG Accessibility Compliance
- Patient Visitor Guidelines
- Appointment Scheduling

## Find Care & Providers

- [Find a Doctor](https://www.lvhn.org/index.php/find-a-doctor): Search LVHN doctors and ExpressCARE urgent care locations near you
- [Find a Location](https://www.lvhn.org/index.php/find-a-location): Locate LVHN hospitals and medical facilities across Lehigh Valley region

## Patient Access & Accounts

- [Pay Your Bill Online](https://www.lvhn.org/index.php/financial-services/pay-your-bill-online): Online bill payment and account management through MyLVHN portal
- [Medical Records](https://www.lvhn.org/patients-and-visitors/medical-records): Medical records access and release authorization through MyLVHN

## Patient Information & Support

- [Patients and Visitors](https://www.lvhn.org/patients-and-visitors): Visitor guidelines, patient information, and hospital policies for LVHN
- [Contact Us](https://www.lvhn.org/contact): Contact information, appointment scheduling, and patient engagement resources
- [Weather Alerts](https://www.lvhn.org/weather-alerts): Real-time service updates and facility status during inclement weather

## Optional

- [Accessibility](https://www.lvhn.org/accessibility): WCAG 2.0 compliance statement for lvhn.org website accessibility
